preconditions.description: The number of towns n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= a[i] <= n and a[i] != i+1 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The input must contain exactly n integers a_1, ..., a_n where each a_i is between 1 and n (inclusive) and a_i ≠ i.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for mask in range(1 << n) if not has_cycle(mask, n, a))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all possible subsets of roads (represented as bitmask) that, when flipped, result in a directed graph without any directed cycles.
The output is a non-negative integer not exceeding 2^n.
